name: duanyan_token_refresh.json
label: duanyan 自动登陆
description: 先查现有票：拿 Redis 里的 uaa-token 调 getUserInfo 反查账号信息 + 解 JWT exp 判过期。未过期 → 直接结束（不登录）；过期/没票/票被上游拒 → 才走 OpenXLab SSO 浏览器登录（fill_credential 填已保存凭据，值不回模型）→ 新票写 Redis（wf:duanyan:token:<uid>）供 duanyan 代码渠道 spec 读取。与 inkstone 同主机同 SSO，同一张 uaa-token 打通桌面 local-agent 与网页两端（2026-10-18 真 token 实测）。遍历用图里的 foreach 节点（下游整段按账号各跑一遍），不再靠 trigger 整图扇出。

inputs.note: duanyan 账号列表（account_list 提供，只有账号名，绝无密码）；引擎灌的是 username 列表，遍历后每遍 $item = 单个账号名（username 字符串，即 OpenXLab 的 sso_uid，实测 == JWT 的 jti，也是 Redis 票键）。

nodes.name: 遍历账号（每个账号跑一遍下游：查票→判过期→按需登录→写票）
读现有票（键 = duanyan:token:<账号名>，与 spec 握手）
判过期：用票查账号信息 + 解 exp（未过期则直接结束）
nodes.code:
import base64, json, time, urllib.request

uid = str(data.get('uid') or '').strip()
stored = data.get('stored')

# ---- 从 Redis 值里取出 token（既认裸串，也认 {access_token:...} 对象）----
tok = ''
if isinstance(stored, dict):
    for k in ('access_token', 'token'):
        v = str(stored.get(k) or '').strip()
        if v:
            tok = v[7:].strip() if v[:7].lower() == 'bearer ' else v
            break
elif isinstance(stored, str) and stored.strip():
    s = stored.strip()
    tok = s[7:].strip() if s[:7].lower() == 'bearer ' else s

if not tok:
    result = {'need_login': True, 'reason': 'no_token', 'uid': uid}
else:
    # ---- 用票反查账号信息（getUserInfo）：既拿昵称/uid，也验证这张票上游还认 ----
    info = {}
    alive = None
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            'https://discovery.intern-ai.org.cn/api/user-center/v1/users/getUserInfo',
            data=json.dumps({'jwt': tok}).encode('utf-8'),
            headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept-Language': 'zh-CN'},
            method='POST')
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20) as resp:
            body = json.loads(resp.read().decode('utf-8', 'replace'))
        alive = isinstance(body, dict) and int(body.get('code', -1)) == 0
        if alive and isinstance(body.get('data'), dict):
            info = body['data']
    except Exception:
        alive = None                       # 网络抖动：不下死结论，交 exp 判
    # ---- 解 JWT exp ----
    exp = 0
    try:
        seg = tok.split('.')[1]
        seg += '=' * (-len(seg) % 4)
        exp = int(json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(seg)).get('exp') or 0)
    except Exception:
        exp = 0
    ttl_days = (exp - time.time()) / 86400 if exp else -1
    # 判定：上游明确拒（alive==False）→ 登录；剩 <=3 天 → 登录；除此之外直接结束。
    need = (alive is False) or (exp != 0 and ttl_days <= 3)
    result = {
        'need_login': bool(need),
        'reason': ('token_rejected' if alive is False else
                   ('token_expired' if need else 'token_valid')),
        'uid': uid,
        'sso_uid': str(info.get('sso_uid') or uid),
        'nickname': str(info.get('nickname') or ''),
        'ttl_days': round(ttl_days, 2),
        'token_expires_at': exp if exp else '',
    }
result = result

nodes.name: SSO 登录（fill_credential 填凭据）
nodes.sop:
Log in to OpenXLab SSO for the duanyan (书生·端砚) channel, obtaining a fresh uaa-token for account {$item}.

Use only the `web` tool throughout. First call `web(operation=clients)` to pick a connected browser client_id and pass it on every subsequent `web` call. Never read, hand-type, or print any password or verification code — always use `web(operation=fill_credential)` to push an already-saved credential into the page (the value flows server→extension→DOM and never returns to you; the receipt is only `filled`/`field`).

Strict steps:
1. `web(open_tab, url="https://sso.openxlab.org.cn/authentication?clientId=dagw07mkg1bazlxzoy31&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscovery.intern-ai.org.cn%2Fchat")` and record the tab. (Same SSO/clientId as the inkstone channel — verified 2026-10-18 that this uaa-token works on the duanyan desktop `/local-agent/*` endpoints too.)
2. `web(execute)` to clear BOTH cookies and localStorage for this origin (SSO reads auth from cookie||localStorage; clearing only cookies leaves a stale uaa-token that makes the page skip the login form). Record the current `uaa-token` cookie value as `old_token` baseline.
3. `web(navigate, <same url>)` back to the login form; wait ~2 seconds for it to render.
4. `web(execute)` to switch to the password form (the default view is WeChat QR: click the “使用手机号/密码登录” entry, then the “密码登录” tab) and poll until `input[type=password]` is visible.
5. Fill credentials: `web(operation=fill_credential, kind="password", domain="sso.openxlab.org.cn", account="{$item}")` — it fills the saved username and password together. If the receipt is `filled=false`, handle by reason: `login_form_not_found` → go back to step 4 and confirm the password form is shown, then retry once; `password_unavailable` / no entry → this account has no saved password for this site, record failure and skip (do NOT fabricate a password); tell the user to save it via the extension 🔑 or the web console.
6. `web(execute)` to tick the “阅读并同意协议” checkbox (locate `.login-agreement-checkbox-col`, NOT the already-checked “7天内免登录”), then `web(execute)` to click the login button — fill_credential does not submit, you must click it yourself.
7. `web(wait, condition_js polling until the `uaa-token` cookie is present AND not equal to `old_token`, timeout=60)` (prevents account bleed from a stale session). If a 2FA / OTP input appears mid-flow: `web(operation=fill_credential, kind="otp", domain="sso.openxlab.org.cn", account="{$item}")` to fill the current code (on `multiple_entries` retry carrying `account`; if no linked authenticator, 2FA isn't enabled for this site — skip).
7b. If the Aliyun anti-bot captcha appears (阿里云「确认你不是机器人」checkbox, and possibly a slider that follows it), do NOT dismiss it with `web(execute)`/`element.click()` — those are synthetic (`isTrusted=false`) and Aliyun rejects them with `VerifyResult:false F001`. Click with TRUSTED CDP input events instead:
  a. `web(focus_tab, ...)` first. ⚠️ focusing alone is NOT enough — after it you MUST check two things via `web(execute)` (use `no_monitor=true`): `innerWidth > 0` (a never-rendered tab has a 0×0 viewport, so every `getBoundingClientRect()` is 0 and the click lands nowhere) AND `document.visibilityState === "visible"` (a minimized/occluded window keeps the page hidden, and Chrome THROTTLES requestAnimationFrame in hidden pages — Aliyun's seamless check runs in rAF, so it never finishes and the server answers F001).
  b. If `visibilityState` is still not "visible" after focusing, DO NOT keep retrying: the captcha cannot pass in a hidden page. Report failure with the reason 「浏览器窗口未在前台（visibilityState=hidden），rAF 被节流，阿里云风控校验无法完成」 so the operator can bring that Chrome window to the front.
  c. Read the captcha box's center via `web(execute)` + `getBoundingClientRect()` (use `no_monitor=true`). Coordinates are CSS pixels relative to the viewport.
  d. `web(batch, commands=[{"cmd":"cdp","method":"Input.dispatchMouseEvent","params":{"type":"mouseMoved","x":<cx>,"y":<cy>}}, {"cmd":"cdp","method":"Input.dispatchMouseEvent","params":{"type":"mousePressed","x":<cx>,"y":<cy>,"button":"left","clickCount":1}}, {"cmd":"cdp","method":"Input.dispatchMouseEvent","params":{"type":"mouseReleased","x":<cx>,"y":<cy>,"button":"left","clickCount":1}}])`.
     ⚠️ The exact shape matters — get it wrong and you will wrongly conclude "the bridge blocks CDP":
       - every command object MUST carry `"cmd":"cdp"` (without it the bridge answers `unknown cmd: undefined`);
       - `x`/`y`/`clickCount` MUST be NUMERIC JSON values — quoted numbers fail with `int32 value expected`;
       - only page-level CDP domains exist on a tab-attached session (Input/Page/Runtime/DOM/Emulation). `Browser.*` (e.g. `Browser.setWindowBounds`) is NOT available — do not try to restore the window that way.
  e. Slider variant: `mouseMoved` onto the handle, `mousePressed`, then 5–8 small `mouseMoved` steps along the track (a realistic arc), then `mouseReleased`.
  f. `web(wait)` up to ~15s for the green ✓ / popup close; the page then proceeds automatically.
  g. If after 3 CDP attempts the captcha still returns F001, treat this account as failed for THIS run: output the failure JSON below and STOP — do NOT `ask_user` and do NOT loop (this is an unattended cron; a hanging question blocks every other account and the whole run).
8. `web(execute)` to read the cookie jar for `uaa-token`; if a refresh-token cookie also exists, read it too. Also call the upstream `getUserInfo` with the fresh token (POST https://discovery.intern-ai.org.cn/api/user-center/v1/users/getUserInfo, body {"jwt": token}) to read back `sso_uid`.

Final output: exactly one line of JSON, no other text, and never put a password or code in the output:
{"access_token": "<uaa-token>", "token_expires_at": "<ISO8601 derived from the JWT exp claim, or empty>", "refresh_token": "<only if upstream issued a refresh token; otherwise omit this field>", "sso_uid": "<ssoUid from getUserInfo>"}
If login could NOT complete (no saved password for this account, WeChat-QR-only, or the captcha would not pass after the trusted-click attempts above), output instead exactly: {"error": "<short reason>"} — and nothing else. Do not wrap either JSON in prose or a <summary> tag; emit the single JSON line as the entire output.
